messages:
alyssa: quick preflight — my SDK PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2145) is blocked on an API change in /api PR 502. need eyes on the api contract and a helm bump for the runtime image tag. aiming for tomorrow's merge window (09:00 UTC). cc @omar @devon @sasha

omar: on it. can you paste the specific interface change? is it a minor param rename or a payload shape change?

alyssa: it's the request body key rename: `model_override` -> `model_variant`. tiny, but console also reads that field so it needs a short compatibility plan. api PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/502

devon: i can review the sdk diff once CI finishes. CI has been flaky — if tests pass i'll approve. any example requests that break?

alyssa: example: POST /v1/generate with body `{..., "model_variant": "xlarge-v2"}`. older SDK still writes `model_override` so we need the SDK patch to serialize the new key and accept the old alias for now. no proto changes, just json shape.

sasha: helm note — runtime chart needs an `image.tag` update and values schema tweak (console.config.modelKey -> runtime.modelKey). i'll open the helm PR after api lands: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/98 (WIP). will add schema entries for the alias too.

jen: console team here — we can read `model_variant` and keep an alias fallback to `model_override` for one release. i'll queue a tiny console PR today, ETA EOD. will add integration test for the new request shape.

alyssa: thanks. also need a short SDK changelog entry and patch release cut after merge + helm bump. can folks :+1: if they can sign off before the window? :rocket:

ci-bot: Travis CI — Build failed for sdk PR #2145: integration-tests timeout. logs: https://ci.redwood.infra/build/1234. to retrigger, comment `/retest`.

devon: looks like the flaky test is `test_kv_cache_eviction`. i'll restart and follow up if it keeps failing. /retest

omar: i can approve the api PR once tests are green. jen — please mark the console PR with `depends-on: api#502` so release tooling picks up the ordering.

jen: will do. i'll add the dependency metadata and request review from @sasha for the helm values change.

alyssa: perfect. last ask — if anyone expects merge conflicts (e.g., proto renames or major schema shifts), flag here now. otherwise i'll lift the SDK PR into the merge window tomorrow morning and coordinate the helm bump immediately after api merge. thanks all! :thumbsup:
